[spoiler=[b][u]The Burning Kingdom[/u]
Embers that Fall[/b]]
[i]World of the blobonu, continues it way of life.
From the dunes of gold to the fields of cultivation.
The nowness is peaceful with its tribes all at rest with moonlight's glow, it will not be long to the day the world burns.

At the hight of the land, a priest wakes groggily, as the environment is acting to not its usual way which has grown worser over the few days.
But the only thing that is awakening the spirit of this priest over the last couple of days is the word, Ember.
Why this word as the priest ponders, as the priest is the listener of the world tree, for this blobon is blessed to have such an important title.
Without the need of its crown of twigs, the blobon exits it chamber of the First Born and heads outside to embrace the bright night.
The air is still but it's unusualy warm, and daybreak hasn't arrived without the need of a clock to tell.
The feeling grows on the priest as duty is known well by generations of Listeners to the world tree, that the tree has given a message and cannot be ignored.
So the blobon at the hight of the world follows the lights of the waiting dead to arrive at the centre of the island.
The world tree is grand and Towering over the jagged rocks that surrounds the ancient lifeform, the pond that the tree sweats into is pure and is said to nurture the first born.

The voice that only one of many spiritual folk can be heard which isn't your usual normal standards as it's not sloppy, kind or tough nor its either cruel, chatty or harmonic.
The voice crackles the air with a raging fire of burning twigs, popping stones and sizzling leaves.
The priest's tired eyes widen to the reality of what's to come, without realising that daybreak has begun on the new day.

Embers start to form from the leaves of the oldest tree and fall to the pond that begins to boil, the god of fire has taken the throne.

And the world burns for the lord of fire has been born.[/i]
[/spoiler]
